notes.title: Counter Display Update (v1.5.0)
notes.content:
A new setting has been added to allow the number of Chopped Logs to be viewed on the gameplay screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415257/165530d7f3084a46bf34e8e7136792173fea3c80.png

By default, this feature is not displayed (unchecked).
If enabled, the counter will appear at the bottom right corner of the gameplay screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415257/dd9b371d31a3e4c4824eab96d52d78388514d9db.png

Thank you.

notes.title: Optimization Update (v1.4.0)
notes.content:
The game has been updated to version 1.4.0 for optimization of system requirements.


Background models have been replaced with ones that use fewer polygons.
Shaders have been adjusted to reduce graphic costs.
The shadow setting has been replaced with overall graphic settings.
This setting adjusts the quality of foliage, shadows, textures, and more.
Anti-aliasing options have been added.
